diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period between completed bodies. The candidate used `period: 0` (one-shot) and included a trailing `delay(3 MIN)`, causing the first cycle body to execute at t=0 and then terminate, missing the required re-arm at t=180000. Evidence F2 shows the IR emits `siren.setsirenmode` at 190000ms (the start of the second cycle), while the candidate emitted nothing.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` to 180000 to match the IR's cycle period. Removed the trailing `delay(3 MIN)` and restructured the script to use a blocking `wait until(true)` at the end of the body to ensure the script completes exactly at the cycle boundary, allowing the wrapper to re-arm correctly for the next iteration.
